project.title: Custodian: the Db2 control plane for AI agents
project.short_description: A gateway that makes IBM Db2 itself the guardrail for AI agents: SQL runs as the human (RCAC masks and row permissions), writes are blast-radius measured against a policy table, risky writes wait for human approval (LangGraph interrupt), and temporal tables let any agent transaction be rewound and any AI answer be replayed as of the moment it was given.

members.name: Ayush Gade
members.role: Design, Db2 integration, gateway, agent, UI, tests

features_used: Row and Column Access Control (CREATE PERMISSION / CREATE MASK)
Per-user authorization IDs and roles (GRANT ... TO ROLE)
System-period temporal tables (FOR SYSTEM_TIME, CURRENT TEMPORAL SYSTEM_TIME)
Data-change table references (FINAL TABLE / OLD TABLE)
